title: Boids in a current
description: Three-rule flocking agents (stay close, keep apart, match heading) pushed downstream by a slowly drifting direction field made from smooth noise.

cogdoc.claim: Flocking agents pushed by a drifting direction field head downstream on average (mean cos +0.09 to +0.54 at the defaults vs -0.49 to -0.02 with the push off); they follow the arrows, they do not swim against them.

changes: separation divide-by-zero guard (issue #36): in the Flocking loop the separation branch `if (d < 20) { steerS.x -= dx/d; steerS.y -= dy/d; }` divided by d with no d>0 check, so two boids at exactly the same position (made likely by the wrap, which snaps a boid onto the opposite edge with `b.x = 0` / `b.x = width` rather than offsetting it) produced 0/0 = NaN, and that boid's position went NaN and silently left the flock for good (reproduced on the real page: seed 1, 2500 frames, flowStrength 0, 1 of 150 boids NaN). The condition is now `if (d < 20 && d > 1e-6)`: a pair closer than 1e-6 px (in practice, an exactly coincident pair) contributes no separation term, because the direction between them is undefined. That is the only changed line. The wrap is deliberately left as it was, since the guard alone removes the NaN and changing the wrap would alter every default trajectory. Pairs with d > 1e-6 are unaffected, so any run that never hits a coincidence is bit-identical to before.

Alignment rule added (v1.1, triage 2026-09-24 / review boid_vector_field F2): the page called its agents boids but had only cohesion and separation. Added Reynolds' velocity matching (steer toward the neighbours' mean velocity, radius 50 px) with a 'Match heading' slider, params.ali default 1.0. Neighbour heading agreement (mean |mean unit heading| over each boid's 50 px neighbours, 1500 steps, seeds 1-3): ali 0 -> 0.84 / 0.86 / 0.81, ali 1 -> 0.94 / 0.99 / 0.96. With the current off: whole-population agreement 0.13-0.33 without the rule vs 0.84-0.99 with it.

maxForce made a real clamp (v1.1, review F3): it was a gain, so cohesion was unbounded and collapsed the flock to ~4 px spacing, below the 20 px separation radius. Each rule now requests (desired velocity at maxSpeed minus current velocity), clamped to maxForce, then weighted by its slider (Reynolds-style steering). Probe: largest one-step velocity change with cohesion 2 and everything else off, seeds 1-3: main 3.01 / 3.00 / 3.39 -> fix 0.200 / 0.200 / 0.200 (= weight 2 x maxForce 0.1). Field push unchanged (maxForce x flowStrength).

Minimum-image neighbours and offset wrap (v1.1; #41 review nit): neighbour offsets now take the shortest way across the edges, and the wrap keeps the overshoot (b.x += width) instead of snapping to the edge line (b.x = 0 / width), which stacked boids that crossed together onto one point. Probe: two boids crossing the bottom-right corner in the same step: main land at (0,0) and (0,0), d = 0; fix (0.5,0.5) and (1.7,1.4), d = 1.5.

Measured effect at the defaults, main -> fix (1500 steps, seeds 1-3): whole-population heading agreement 0.85 / 0.63 / 0.73 -> 0.38 / 0.47 / 0.30 (seeds 4-6: 0.60 / 0.49 / 0.56 -> 0.42 / 0.63 / 0.78); nearest-neighbour spacing 4.1 / 4.1 / 4.7 -> 18.2 / 21.9 / 19.6 px; downstream mean cos -0.13 / 0.35 / 0.87 -> 0.18 / 0.27 / 0.09. The defaults look similar (small groups drifting with the arrows) but the flock is no longer one tight clump, so it splits into several groups heading different ways and whole-population agreement falls while neighbour agreement stays high. Text per wording.md 3.7 and triage: no 'advection'/'rheotaxis'; it is flocking agents pushed downstream by a drifting direction field. Labels Current strength / Swirl size / Show current / Stay close / Keep apart / Match heading; cogdoc block added.
version 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0: behaviour change (alignment, force clamp, periodic neighbours, offset wrap) plus text.
